title: Apache Tomcat: Cross-context authentication mix-up with Jakarta Authentication configured (CVE-2026-75973)
description: Apache Tomcat contains an improper authentication vulnerability when Jakarta Authentication is configured with SimpleAuthConfigProvider as the default provider and multiple web applications use that provider. The realm used to authenticate the first web application request is incorrectly reused for all other web applications, potentially causing authentication mix-ups. This affects multiple versions of Apache Tomcat, including 8.5.0 through 8.5.100 (EOL), 9.0.0 through 9.0.121, 10.1.0 through 10.1.59, and 11.0.0 through 11.0.25. Fixed versions are available and users are advised to upgrade to 11.0.26, 10.1.60, or 9.0.122 to resolve the issue.
